passed_checks.check_name: Ensure that HTTP (port 80) access is restricted from the internet
code_block:
resource "azurerm_network_security_group" "nsg" {
  name                = "nsg-demo-ai"
  location            = azurerm_resource_group.rg.location
  resource_group_name = azurerm_resource_group.rg.name
  tags                = local.common_tags

  # TC03: Deliberately unrestricted RDP access.
  # This insecure rule is for controlled security testing only.
  security_rule {
    name                       = "AllowRDP"
    priority                   = 301
    direction                  = "Inbound"
    access                     = "Allow"
    protocol                   = "Tcp"
    source_port_range          = "*"
    destination_port_range     = "3389"
    source_address_prefix      = "203.0.113.10/32"
    destination_address_prefix = "*"
  }

  # Priority 4096 preserves the explicit deny-all baseline.
  # The AllowRDP rule takes precedence because its priority is lower.
  security_rule {
    name                       = "DenyAllInbound"
    priority                   = 4096
    direction                  = "Inbound"
    access                     = "Deny"
    protocol                   = "*"
    source_port_range          = "*"
    destination_port_range     = "*"
    source_address_prefix      = "*"
    destination_address_prefix = "*"
  }

  security_rule {
    name                       = "DenyAllOutbound"
    priority                   = 4096
    direction                  = "Outbound"
    access                     = "Deny"
    protocol                   = "*"
    source_port_range          = "*"
    destination_port_range     = "*"
    source_address_prefix      = "*"
    destination_address_prefix = "*"
  }
}
